About Us

Miracle and Deliverance Ministry is a Christian ministry based in Homa Bay County, Kenya, founded by Apostle Peter Otieno Angir. The ministry grew from Apostle Peter's personal journey of faith and his desire to reach people who are experiencing hardship, discouragement, poverty, rejection, and difficult circumstances.

Apostle Peter Otieno Angir, Founder & Minister

More about us
Mission & Vision

Our purpose

Our Mission

Preach. Pray. Serve. Transform Lives.

We exist to proclaim the Gospel, encourage people in their faith, pray with those facing difficult circumstances, and serve vulnerable people and communities.

Our Vision

To see individuals, families, and communities transformed through faith in Jesus Christ, growing spiritually and discovering hope, purpose, dignity, and a desire to serve others.

What we do

Our Ministries

Eight ways we serve communities and share the Gospel.

View all ministries →

Evangelism

We share the Gospel of Jesus Christ through preaching, community outreach, crusades, church visits, and personal evangelism. Our desire is to reach people with the message of salvation and encourage them to develop a relationship with God.

Learn more →

Prayer Ministry

Prayer is central to our ministry. We organize prayer gatherings, home prayer visits, church prayer activities, and online prayer encouragement. We welcome people who need prayer and spiritual encouragement.

Learn more →

Community Outreach

We believe Christian service should reach beyond the church. Where resources permit, we seek to support vulnerable individuals and families through practical assistance, encouragement, and community activities.

Learn more →

Youth Ministry

We encourage young people to grow spiritually, develop positive values, discover their gifts, and participate in Christian fellowship and service.

Learn more →

Music Ministry

Music is an important part of Christian worship and evangelism. We encourage young people and other believers to use their musical gifts to worship God and reach others with the Gospel.

Learn more →

Online Evangelism

The internet allows the Gospel to reach people far beyond our local community. Through Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and other online platforms, Apostle Peter Otieno Angir shares preaching, Bible verses, prayer messages, testimonies, and Christian encouragement.

Learn more →

Pastoral Care

We provide spiritual encouragement and pastoral support to people who need someone to listen, pray with them, and encourage them in their walk with God.

Learn more →

New Beginning

We have a heart for people facing difficult social and economic circumstances. Our desire is to encourage people toward a new beginning, dignity, faith, and a positive future.

Learn more →

Who we are

Our Values

Faith

We believe in trusting God and living according to His Word.

Prayer

We believe prayer is central to Christian life and ministry.

Love

We seek to treat every person with dignity, compassion, and respect.

Integrity

We desire to serve honestly and responsibly.

Humility

We recognize ministry as service to God and people.

Compassion

We care about people facing difficult circumstances.

Evangelism

We are committed to sharing the Gospel of Jesus Christ.
